info.title: Tetrac Market Data API
info.description:
Read-only crypto market data from Tetrac — tickers, funding rates, open interest,
new listings, volume, Solana perps positioning, news, economic calendar, market
insights and the Tetrac technical scanner across centralized and decentralized
exchanges. No exchange account or exchange API keys are involved.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except the free `/api/v1/markets` discovery index requires one of:

- **Session auth** — pass `ttc-auth-token` (Bearer) + `ttc-public-key` header for registered Tetrac users.
- **x402 micropayment** — pass a signed Solana USDC payment ($0.05 standard, $0.50 for the full-market scanner snapshot) in the `x-x402-payment` header.
  See [x402.json](https://www.tetrac.xyz/.well-known/x402.json) for payment details.

get.summary: List market data endpoints and their prices
get.description: Free discovery index for every `/api/v1/markets/*` endpoint — no payment and no session required. Returns `{pricing, methods}`: `pricing` is the standard per-request price of the listed endpoints `{amount, currency, network, per}`, and `methods` is keyed by sub-route slug (e.g. `funding-rates`) with `{name, path, method, description, price: {amount, currency}}` per entry, plus `params` on the entries that take query parameters, so an agent can see what each paid endpoint costs before paying for any of them. Rate-limited per client (per account when a session is presented); over the limit it returns 429 with `Retry-After`. (Free)

method.description: HTTP method, or an array when the endpoint accepts several

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns the cross-exchange **perpetual futures** ticker set from one server-side cache: `data.futures.data` is an array of `Ticker` objects (Binance-style 24h fields, numeric values as decimal strings), where `source`/`sources` name the venues that list each market and `volumeByExchange` splits its volume by venue. Use it to screen markets in one paid call instead of calling each venue. Every filter is optional; a missing, non-numeric or out-of-range value is ignored rather than rejected. `health` returns the cache's health record instead of tickers. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Market type. Only `futures` is served; any other value is ignored and futures are returned.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Exact symbol match (upper-cased before comparing).

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Keep only markets listed on this venue (matched against `source` and `sources`, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: minimumVolume
parameters.description: Minimum 24h quote volume in USD (`quoteVolume`).

parameters.name: minimumPrice
parameters.description: Minimum `lastPrice`. Swapped with `maximumPrice` if it is the larger of the two.

parameters.name: maximumPrice
parameters.description: Maximum `lastPrice`.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Keep markets whose 24h `priceChangePercent` is at least this value.

parameters.name: down
parameters.description: Keep markets down at least this many percent over 24h.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: Any value: return `data` = `{status, redis, lastError, lastSuccessfulFetch, timeSinceLastFetch}` (the ticker cache's health) instead of tickers.

warning.description: Optional advisory about the cache's state

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: Fetch perpetual funding rates across venues
get.description:
Returns an array of perpetual-futures funding entries (`exchange`, `symbol`, `fundingRate`, `intervalHours`, `hourlyRate`, `dailyRoi`, `nextFundingTime`) live across major perp venues. Use to spot funding-rate arbitrage between venues, monitor extreme rates that signal crowded positioning, or rank perps by funding cost. Optional filters: `symbol`, `exchange` and `arb`. A top-level `error` string lists venues that failed during the refresh, when any did. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

**Comparing venues:** `fundingRate` is each venue's NATIVE per-interval rate, and that interval differs per MARKET — not merely per exchange. A single venue commonly runs 1h, 4h and 8h markets side by side, so raw `fundingRate` values are not comparable across rows. Use `hourlyRate` (rate normalized to a 1-hour basis) for any cross-venue comparison, and `dailyRoi` (`hourlyRate` x 24) for a rough 24h projection.

`hourlyRate` and `dailyRoi` are **omitted** when the market's settlement interval could not be established, rather than being estimated from a default. `intervalSource` is always present and is `unknown` in exactly that case.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Only this symbol. Also widens the query to venues that have no bulk funding endpoint, which are skipped when no symbol is given; rows are then sorted by exchange.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Comma-separated venue ids to keep (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: arb
parameters.description: Return only the N highest and N lowest `fundingRate` rows, sorted by `fundingRate` descending.

error.description: Present when some venues failed during the refresh

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: Fetch open interest by market from one venue
get.description: Returns the latest open-interest snapshot from one venue — chosen by `source`, default `bybit` — for the Binance perpetual markets that venue also lists, sorted by 24h volume: `{data: [{symbol, openInterest, openInterestUsd, price, volumeUsd, timestamp}], timestamp, source}`. Numeric values are decimal strings. The snapshot is cached for 5 minutes. Use to detect open-interest build-up that often precedes price moves. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Venue to read open interest from. An unsupported value falls back to `bybit`.

source.description: The venue the open interest came from

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

500.description: Unexpected error, or the snapshot could not be fetched on a cold cache

get.description:
Returns the latest new-listings delta for **perpetual futures**: the cross-exchange futures ticker set is diffed against a rolling 24h set of known symbols, and markets that newly appeared are returned as `Ticker` objects. The result is cached for 1 hour, so concurrent callers see a stable answer; after that the known set advances and the next call produces the next delta.

The payload is nested one level deeper than most endpoints: `data.data` holds `{newListings, totalCount, previousCount}`, `data.timestamp` is when the snapshot was computed and `data.cached` whether it came from the 1-hour cache. The outer `timestamp` is the response time and the outer `cached` is always `false`.

($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

previousCount.description: Size of the known-symbols set before this snapshot

timestamp.description: Epoch ms when the snapshot was computed

cached.description: True if served from the 1-hour snapshot cache

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns one entry per perpetual venue with its 24h snapshot: `{exchange, displayName, chain, timestamp, totalVolume24h, totalOpenInterest, tvl?, markets[{symbol, volume24h, openInterest?, price, fundingRate?, priceChange24h?}], status, error?}`. Only venues whose fetch succeeded are included. Cached for 60 seconds; when served from cache, `timestamp` is the last update. An optional top-level `error` string reports a degraded refresh. Use to rank venues by liquidity or track volume moving between them. Filter by `exchange`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Only this venue (exact id, case-insensitive)

error.description: Present when the refresh was degraded

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns up to 30 daily entries `{date, volume, timestamp}`. `volume` is the day's peak of the summed 24h volume (USD) across the venues in `/api/v1/markets/volume-snapshot` — perpetual venues, not DEX swaps, despite the route name. `data` is empty until history has been recorded. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: List which exchanges quote a given symbol
get.description: Returns which venues list each symbol: `data.symbolVenues` maps an upper-cased symbol to the sorted venue ids that offer a market for it. This is a listings index (does a venue offer the market), not a price aggregate — use it to find where a symbol trades before calling a venue-specific endpoint. Served from a 24-hour cache; `data.updatedAt` is the build time (epoch ms), `data.venueCount` the number of venues that contributed at least one symbol, and `cached` whether the call was served from that cache. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: Run the Tetrac technical scan for one symbol
get.description: Runs a multi-timeframe Quadrant-lines technical scan for one symbol. Returns `{params: {symbol, timeframe, bars, swingStrength}, data: {symbol, price, scans, scoring, signal, breakout}}`: `scans` holds the per-timeframe scan results, `scoring` the long/short fan-line scores, `signal` the trade signal (`direction` LONG|SHORT|NEUTRAL, `strength`, `confidence`, `entry`, `stopLoss`, `takeProfit1..3`, `riskRewardRatio`, `reasoning`; the levels are `null` when no trade is signalled) and `breakout` a volatility-squeeze breakout read. Use as a one-call signal generator for one symbol and timeframe. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market symbol

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Kline interval, e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 1w. The value is passed to the exchange as-is; an unsupported one returns 500.

parameters.name: bars
parameters.description: Number of historical bars to analyze. Defaults to 1000 (the maximum); fewer than 50 bars of history returns 500.

parameters.name: swingStrength
parameters.description: Pivot sensitivity in bars; higher values report only larger swings. Defaults to 10.

scans.description: One scan per timeframe: pivot, fan angles, zone, momentum and per-side risk/reward

scoring.description: Long and short fan-line scores, the pivots they are measured from, and `preferredDirection`

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

500.description: Unexpected error, an unsupported timeframe, or fewer than 50 bars of history

get.summary: Fetch the full-market Tetrac scanner snapshot
get.description:
The latest cached technical-analysis signals for every scanned market. Without parameters it returns only the snapshot's freshness — `generatedAt` and `staleAtMs` (epoch ms; `generatedAt` is `null` before the first sweep) — so a client can check age before fetching. `?full=1` returns the snapshot itself: `data: {generatedAt, universe, symbols[{symbol, quoteVolume, signal, breakout}], meta: {universeSize, scanned, skipped, durationMs, submitted?, dropped?}}`. Both modes are priced the same, so pass `full=1` to receive the signals.

The snapshot counts as stale 55 minutes after `generatedAt` (`staleAtMs`). Tetrac's app refreshes it at most once every 55 minutes, on no fixed schedule, so check `staleAtMs` before relying on the signals. ($0.50 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: `1` returns the full snapshot in `data`; omit it for the freshness fields only.

200.description: Snapshot freshness, or the full snapshot with ?full=1

generatedAt.description: Without full=1: epoch ms of the last sweep, null if none

staleAtMs.description: Epoch ms when the snapshot becomes eligible for a refresh, or null if none exists yet

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns up to 10 recent news items from the Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT feed (topics: technology, IPO, earnings, financial markets), cached for 5 minutes: `items: [{title, url, time_published, summary, source, impact_score, sentiment}]`. `time_published` uses Alpha Vantage's `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS` format; `impact_score` is the item's overall sentiment score × 100 (signed). ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: List momentum movers with funding context
get.description: Returns the cross-exchange perpetual tickers with 24h quote volume ≥ $1M and 24h price change ≥ 1% — full `Ticker` objects, each with an optional `fundingArb` list of `"exchange: rate%"` strings — plus `tickersCount` and `fundingArbCount`. No query parameters are read. `data.cached.futures` reports whether the ticker set came from cache; the top-level `cached` is always `false`. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Medium- and high-impact macro-economic events for this week and next — central-bank rate decisions, FOMC, CPI, NFP, GDP and more — from the Forex Factory calendar, sourced via x402node and cached for 24 hours: `data: {events: [CalendarEvent], source, fromCache, fetchedAt, expiresAt, ageSeconds, truncated}`. Events are keyed by the currency they move and include forecast, previous and (once released) actual values as published. Filters: `currency` (comma-separated codes; `country` is accepted as an alias), `impact` (exact level), `search` (case-insensitive substring of `event`) and `from`/`to` (UTC dates, inclusive). ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Comma-separated currency codes to keep (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: impact
parameters.description: Exact impact level (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of `event`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest UTC date, inclusive

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest UTC date, inclusive

fromCache.description: True when served from the 24-hour snapshot

fetchedAt.description: Epoch ms the snapshot was fetched

truncated.description: True when the provider returned its full page, so more events may exist

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

500.description: Unexpected error, or the calendar provider could not be paid or reached

get.description: Returns the USGS "significant earthquakes, past day" GeoJSON feed unchanged: `data: {type, metadata, features[], bbox?}`, where each feature carries USGS `properties` (`mag`, `place`, `time`, `tsunami`, `sig`, …), `geometry` and `id`. It contains no market data. `timestamp` is when the server cached the feed, which can be older than the request. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.summary: Fetch Solana perp long/short OI ratios
get.description: Open-interest snapshot across Solana perpetual venues, collected server-side in one pass. `rows` holds venues that publish a genuine long-vs-short split (`{venue, symbol, longUsd, shortUsd, longPositions, shortPositions}` — the position counts are `null` whenever a venue publishes none, which is currently every venue); `totals` holds venues that publish combined open interest only (`{venue, symbol, totalUsd}`); `venueStatus` maps each venue id to `ok` or `error`, so a degraded source is visible instead of silently missing. `fetchedAt` is when the snapshot was assembled; the per-venue data behind it can be up to a minute older. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: venues
parameters.description: Comma-separated venue ids (case-insensitive) that `rows` and `totals` are narrowed to. Omit for every venue; the valid ids are the keys of `venueStatus`.

200.description: Long/short and total open-interest rows per venue and symbol

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

get.description: Returns the top Pacifica trader accounts ranked by current open-interest notional, trimmed to `{address, label, oiUsd}` each, plus `totalRanked` (accounts on the upstream leaderboard) and `fetchedAt`. `label` is `null` when the trader set no username or enabled privacy mode. Accounts with no open interest are left out, so `accounts` can be shorter than `limit`. Built for subscribing to those accounts on Pacifica's public WebSocket — this endpoint is address discovery only and carries no trade events itself. The upstream leaderboard is refreshed at most every 5 minutes; `fetchedAt` is the response time. ($0.05 USDC on Solana mainnet)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of accounts to return (parsed as an integer). Values above the maximum are capped; a non-positive or unparseable value falls back to the default.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after `Retry-After` seconds

Ticker.description: Binance-style 24h ticker for one perpetual market; numeric values are decimal strings

sources.description: Every venue that lists this market

fundingRate.description: The venue's NATIVE rate for one settlement interval, as a decimal fraction (0.0001 = 0.01%). NOT comparable across rows — see hourlyRate.

intervalHours.description: This market's settlement interval in hours. Omitted when it could not be established.

intervalSource.description: How intervalHours was determined. Always present; "unknown" means the rate is un-normalized and hourlyRate/dailyRoi are absent.

hourlyRate.description: fundingRate normalized to a 1-hour basis. The cross-venue comparable. Omitted when intervalHours is unknown.

dailyRoi.description: hourlyRate x 24 — a hypothetical 24h projection, not compounded. Omitted when hourlyRate is.

nextFundingTime.description: Epoch milliseconds of the next settlement.

openInterest.description: Open interest, when the venue reports it
Open interest in base units (3 decimals)

CalendarEvent.description: One economic event, normalized from the Forex Factory calendar

country.description: The currency the event moves (the provider keys events by currency)

previous.description: Last published value, as displayed (unit included)

actual.description: Released value, as displayed; null until the release

BreakoutSignal.description: Volatility-squeeze breakout read for the same market

AuthToken.name: ttc-auth-token
AuthToken.description: Session token from Tetrac login (24-hour expiry)

PublicKey.name: ttc-public-key
PublicKey.description: Solana public key associated with the session token

X402Payment.name: x-x402-payment
X402Payment.description: Signed Solana USDC micropayment ($0.05 standard, $0.50 for the full-market scanner snapshot) — alternative to session auth
